info.title: Webdock Mail API
info.description: Transactional Mail. Accepted means provider acceptance, not delivery. JSON limit 4,000,000 bytes; text+HTML 512 KiB. Requests 120/minute/tenant. Unknown handoffs must never be resent with a new key. Webhooks: HMAC-SHA256 over id.timestamp.rawBody, at-least-once.
